text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
One day, as {0} was spending time at
the guild house, an unexpected guest came to
visit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日、
{0}がギルドハウスで過ごしていると、
意外な人物が訪ねてきた。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Princess Knight. Did Kiiro come around
your place at all?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よお、
プリンセスナイト。
おまえんとこにキイロ、
来てねーか？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Stuff happened, I didn't really have a
choice. Ah, geez, where the hell did she
go...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ。
ちっとばかし事情があって、
仕方なくな。
あーもう、
一体どこ行きやがったんだよ……

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Nothing to worry your brain over. I was
suddenly summoned to the Demon's Foot Citadel
and then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どーしたもこーしたもねーっつの。
いきなり鬼岩城塞に呼び出されたと思ったら──

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, wassup~? I already turned in my
report, y'know~? Oh♡ Could it be you're ready
to sponsor my Kariza-kyun Land~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おねえちゃん、
どった～？
ホーコクショはも～
出してるっしょ。
あ♡　
や～っとカリザきゅんランド
スポンサーする気になったっぽ～？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
I have certainly read your report quite
carefully. Your conjecture, that the
weakening of the "Walls Between Worlds" stems
from repeated "Reconstructions" is, at a
glance, a sound one. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
此度の報告、
遍く精読せり。
世界の間の壁、
脆薄と化した故を
再々構築の名残と推し測るは
先ず先ずの考察也。
なれど……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
The remainder consists merely of your
frivolous musings on young boys and on
sweets. With such trifling dedication, the
path toward realizing this "Kariza-kyun Land"
lies far beyond your reach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
他は男の子を愛ずる己の放言と
甘味の所感ばかり也。
斯様な様では
カリザきゅんランドなる施設、
成就への道程は
遥か彼方であろう喃。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Nea. It is about time you showed me your true
strength. If it remains yet unseen... you
will not overcome the trials to come.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネアや。
そろそろ本手を見せておくんなんし。
己の真の力、
未だ顕わるることなし、
となれば……
何れ来る難局
乗り越えるに能わず。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: That so...? My true power...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホンテ……？
真の力……？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that~... If I could've done
that, I'd have from the start~. Not like I
can just unlock it since you told me, can I~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンなこと言われても～
出せるもんなら
最初から出してっし。
出せって言われて
出るようなもんじゃねーっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
You are not wrong. Then first, go... travel
beneath the open sky, and reflect upon
yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうさ喃。
先ずは旅の空の下、
己の裡を見つめなおすが良かろうて。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Some kind of journey of
self-discovery~? Seriously~? Do I really have
to do this~? Ugh, what a drag~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン・
自分探しの旅
ってやつ？
マジ？　
行かなきゃダメ？　
だる～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
What now... Should I go to Knight-kyun's
place? But going in with no plan kinda
sucks~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どーすっかなー
騎士きゅんトコ行ってくっかー
でも
ノープランてのもなー

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...And so, she set out. Yet, no matter how
much time passed, my little sister shows no
sign of returning. Young Kariza, I would ask
that you keep watch over her. See her through
her journey, and lend her aid when needed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──と、
出立と相成ったものの、
いくら経っても
妹子は戻らぬ儘。
些とばかり様子見を御願い致しとう御座んす、
カリザ坊や。
我が妹子の本手を見守り
扶けてくだしゃんせ。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
HUH?! Why the hell are you asking me to do
something like that?! If she's out on some
journey, then what's the trouble? It's all
peaceful and nice around, so we could just
leave this as is--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！？　
なんでオレがンなことしなきゃなんねーんだよっ！？
アイツが旅に出てるってんなら
平和でいいじゃねえか。
ほっといたって別に……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Young Kariza. I have personally lent you an
hand in the search for Lord Zane and your
other friends... And yet, you would refuse
even this small request?
text_block_list.orig_text:
カリザ坊や。
承前からのゼーン殿らの捜索、
わっちも力添え致し候えども──
お前さまは、
手伝いの一つも御免被ると
そう仰せかえ？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
...Tch! If you're so worried about your
sister, don't send her off in some lame
journey in the first place! You should have
taken care of her yourself from start to
finish!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……チッ！　
妹が心配なら
最初から放り出すんじゃねえ！
テメーで最初から最後まで
面倒見やがれってんだ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.orig_text: 翌日──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
I heard that young Kariza left this morning.
So this must be... a parting gift from him.
Dear Mia, a mirror.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カリザ坊は
今朝がた出立の由。
なればこれは……
坊やの置き土産に相違無し。
ミーアや、
鏡を。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, I'll bring it right away~ I wasn't
really comfortable about telling you about it
myself, so I thought it'd be better if you
just took a look yourself~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
はい、
ただいまお持ちしますね～
私が口にするのもちょっと……
ですので
見ていただいたほうが良いかと。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Go ahead. ...Mm, I see. Just the sort
of petty revenge one would expect from that
boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フフ……
どぉれ。
──成程成程。
カリザ坊らしい意趣返しよ喃。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Ah... did you perhaps let him write it on
purpose? You should have stopped him~ It
looks like it'll be quite difficult to erase,
you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
もしかして、
わざと書かせてあげたんですか～？
止めればいいのに。
消すの、
なかなか大変そうですよ～？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Korokorokorokoro. Such charming childish
mischief... hardly worth taking offense over.
So long as the child is lively and well, all
is as it should be. ...Would you not agree,
Mia?
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロコロ。
愛らしき児戯、
立てる目くじらなどありんせん。
子どもは元気であれば
善哉、
善哉。
──であろ？　
ミーアや。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
And so... if that idiot can't unleash her
true power, things are going to be a pain in
the ass.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──っつーわけで、
あのバカが真の力とやらを引き出せねぇと、
色々メンドーなんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't believe she's not here
either... That bastard... when I find her,
I'm going to make her pay! No, I'll kill her
after she's unleashed this real power of
hers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
ここにもいねぇとはな……
あのヤロー
見つけたら、
ブチ殺してやる……！
いや、
本手とやらを習得させてからブチ殺す！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Princess Knight! Mm... Tell me if you
find her! Don't just shelter her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあな、
プリンセスナイト！
見つけたら教えろよ！　
匿ったりすんじゃねーぞ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After Kariza left, a certain place came to
{0}'s mind. To search for Nea, he
paid it a visit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
カリザが去った後、
ある場所が思い浮かんだ{0}。
ネアを捜して、
その場所へ赴くと──

text_block_list.name: Childrens
text_block_list.text: Big Sis Nea, we love you~...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネアおねえちゃん、
だいすき～……！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm~♪ This is blissful~ The vibes are so
on~♪ At this rate, I might just unleash all
my power~♪ Okay, once more~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン～♪　
たまんね～　
マジアガる～♪
このチョーシで
ホンテってやつができちゃったりして～♪
んじゃ、
ワンスモア～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh~ If it isn't Knight-kyun♪ Been doing well?
I'm over the moon here♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
騎士きゅんじゃ～ん♪
元気してた～？　
アタシは絶好チョ～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
No good, I'm getting a nosebleed♡ Wait, it's
you Knight-kyun♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっべ、
ハナヂでる～♡
って、
騎士きゅんじゃ～ん♪

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfuuu... As you can see, I'm on a part-time
job to take care of those kids~♪ While on
some journey of self discovery I might've
just found my calling~ I wonder why I didn't
realize it until now~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
見ての通り
キッズの面倒見るバイトっすわ～♪
自分探しの旅で、
天職見つけたったー
なーんで
今まで気づかんかったかな～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for real? Was Kariza-kyun feeling lonely
or something? I'll give him some attention
later~ But for now, I have to unleash this
"true power" that Big Sis told me about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
マジ？　
カリザきゅん寂しがってた？
後でカワいがってやっか～
でもとりま、
おねえちゃんに言われた
真の力とやらを出さなくちゃでさ。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
I also have to look after those kids... and I
feel like this'll allow me to show my true
power or something~? It really gets my vibes
going, after all! So, yeah... just a little
more, I guess~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キッズの面倒も見なきゃだし、
ここなら
真の力ってーのも
出せそーだし？
めっちゃアガるんだよね～、
ココ。
だから
あともーちょい、
的な？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good♪ Let's decide on the next
class, then♡ Knight-kyuuun, how old are you~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
やり～♪　
んじゃ～
クラス決めよっか♡
騎士きゅ～ん
なんちゃいでしゅか～？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Yeees♡ Napping, singing... Nfufufu~♪ And
taking a B-A-T-H together, too♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いぇーす♡
お昼寝したりー　
お歌うたったり～　
ンフフフ～♪
お・
ふ・
ろ・
も♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Anyway~? It's time to play outside, so let's
go~♪ Join the kids so we can all play tag~
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりま～？
お外遊びの時間だから、
いこ～♪
キッズに混じって
めーっちゃ
鬼ごっこしたげる～

text_block_list.name: Child 1
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Big Siiiis Nea! You're "it" so come
over! Hurry, hurry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははは！
ネアおねえちゃーん！　
おーにさんこちらっ！　
早く早くっ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I just can't anymore. Give me time,
running's a drag... Seriously, kids have
endless stamina... Big Sis Nea's thighs are
about to explode...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いや、
もームリ。
タンマ、
走んのつれーわ……
つか
キッズの体力
無限すぎんだわ……
ネアおねえちゃん、
太もも爆発しそ～……

text_block_list.name: Child 1
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha! Then you better chase after us,
mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃはははっ！　
鬼さんこちらーっ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Wooow. So you're also a physical powerhouse,
Knight-kyun~... I'm no good at sports, so
it's probably impossible for me to keep up
with you all. I'll relax and watch over you
from here~
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ。
騎士きゅんも体力おばけだったか～……
運動苦手勢なアタシには～　
キッズとハシャぎ続けんのムリめだし～？
ここで見守りながら、
目のホヨーしよ～

text_block_list.name: Child 2
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh? Big Sis Nea, are you going to stop
playing tag already?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ～
ネアおねえちゃん
もう鬼ごっこやめちゃうの？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Makes sense, I guess? Even so, my hips
are, like, crazy heavy right now~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……
なるほど？
つっても、
腰も激オモなんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know~ Maybe I'd be able to do my best
with your support, Knight-kyun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーだな～
騎士きゅんの応援で、
がんばれるかもー？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Is this your power of strengthening? Nfufufu~
I'm getting excited~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
コレが強化の力
ってかー？
ンフフ～　
たぎっちゃうな～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Wha...? Are you for real?! Guess I'll have to
give it my all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マ？　
ガチじゃん！？
こりゃ、
アタシもがんばらなきゃだわ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh~♡ Damn~ This feels so good~♪ I feel
like I'm melting~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン・
ン～♡　
やべ～
キモチイイ～♪
おねえちゃん、
溶けそ～♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfu... I'm fully charged up~♡ I knew it,
there's really some nutrients only you can
give me, Knight-kyun~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
みなぎってきた～♡
やっぱ、
騎士きゅんからしか得られない栄養ってあるんだねー♪

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Or rather... it's like I'm being taken care
of by you? Well, whatever~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
つか、
アタシが騎士きゅんに
お世話されてるよーな？
ま、いっかー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Well now... let's catch them all♪ Hehehe~
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
全員捕まえっか～♪
ンフフ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Alright~ outdoor playtime is over! It got
pretty fun when I got serious about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほーい、
外遊び
しゅーりょ～
ガチると、
それなりにおもろかったわー

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Ah, guess I forgot~ Those boys were just too
cute~ More importantly~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
忘れちった～
ショタかわいすぎんだも～ん。
そ
れ
よ
り～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Next, it's nap time~! Here we go~... a slime
water-bed♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
次は、
お昼寝タイムだよー
そーれっ、
スライムの
ウォーターベッド～♪

text_block_list.name: Child 1
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah! Amazing! It's so squishy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ～
すご～い！
ぷにぷにしてるよ！

text_block_list.name: Child 2
text_block_list.text: Jump, jump~! Ahaha, it's like a trampoline!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジャンプ、
ジャンプ～！
あははっ、
トランポリンみたい！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
No, I made that because I wanted you to
sleep~ Was the slime bed unnecessary?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
寝てほしーんだが～
スライムベッド
余計だったかー？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's a good plan♪ Kids love copying
what they see~
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
イイ作戦じゃん♪
キッズって
マネしたがるもんね～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Then... I'll give you a special arm pillow♪
Knight-kyun, let's doze off together~
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
トクベツに
腕枕してあげる♪
騎士きゅん、
一緒にスヤろっか～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfuuuu... This is bad! You're so close♪ We're
totally in kissy-kissy range, Knight-kyun~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
やば！　
ちか～い♪
騎士きゅんと
チュッチュできる距離じゃ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That was fast, wasn't it~? I'm actually
panting so much, I don't think I'll be able
to sleep~
text_block_list.orig_text:
マ？　
早くね？
むしろハァハァしちって、
アタシは
寝れそーにないんだがー

text_block_list.name: Child 1
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's not fair...! Me too, me too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ズルい……！
ボクもボクもー！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, we're surrounded~ And everyone's
taking a nap~♪ Or rather... isn't this
heaven~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
囲まれちった～
みんなもお昼寝だね～♪
てか
天国か～？

text_block_list.name: Child 3
text_block_list.text: ……Hmph.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふん。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Hmm~...? What's wrong with you guys~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンー……？
どした～
キミら～？

text_block_list.name: Child 3
text_block_list.text:
We don't wanna sleep. And there's no way we'd
do it together anyway!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレたちは眠らねー
仲よく昼寝なんてごめんだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Child 4
text_block_list.text: Right, right! We'll do what we wanna do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーよそーよ！
やりたいようにやらせてもらうわ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is, huh~ Kids are always so
mischievous~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーゆうカンジかー
いいね～
キッズはやんちゃなもんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, let's have a competition! So, whoever
falls asleep first gets first pick of candy~
Yehello~
text_block_list.orig_text:
おし、
みんなで競争しよっかー
眠った順に、
この後好きなお菓子選べる
ってコトで
よろ～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Last place gets turned into gummy candy
thanks to my slime~ Well then, see ya~ Zzz.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最下位には、
ゼラチナでグミ作ってやっから～
んじゃ、
お先～　
すやぁ。

text_block_list.name: Child 3
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! That's not fair!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おい！　
ずりーぞ！

text_block_list.name: Child 4
text_block_list.text:
BOSS! I DON'T WANNA GET TURNED INTO GUMMY BY
A SLIME!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボス！
あたし、
ゼラチナのグミなんて食べたくないわ！

text_block_list.name: Child 3
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Can't be helped, let's take a nap
right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
チッ……
仕方ねぇ、
今すぐ昼寝だっ！

text_block_list.name: ネア
text_block_list.text:
ンフ・
うまくいったったー♪
やっぱコレ
天職なんじゃねー？
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
うまくいったったー♪
やっぱコレ
天職なんじゃねー？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
That said, I can't find any clues about this
"true strength" she spoke of. I wonder if
we're missing something...? Fwaaah... oh
well. Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
つっても、
ホンテの手がかりは見つかんねーけど。
何か足りないんかな～？
……
ふぁ……
ま～
い～や。
すやぁ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having finished their work, Nea and
{0} were on their way back to the
city of Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事を終えたネアと{0}は
ランドソルの街への帰路についていた。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Knight-kyuuun, for today... thank youuuuu!
Wanna go get a parfait? It's my treat♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅ～ん、
今日はせんきゅ～
とりま、
パフェでも食い行くー？
おねーちゃんの
おごり♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this place... isn't it where I first
arrived in Astrum? I crossed the "Wall" back
then... How nostalgic~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
てかこの辺、
アタシが初めてアストルムに来たトコじゃん。
『カベ』越えてさー
なっつかし～！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh~! It hurts, it hurts! So this is
Astrum~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン・
ン～！
つーいたついたー
ここがアストルムか～

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Passing through here with you, Knight-kyun...
feels almost like fate, doesn't it? I
couldn't find any hints about this "true
power" thing, but today was such a great day♪
...Hmm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士きゅんと一緒にここ通るなんて、
な～んか運命っぽ？
ホンテとかゆーののヒントは見つかんなかったけど、
今日って
めっちゃいい日だったじゃ～ん♪　
……ン？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
AAAH! SO THIS IS WHERE YOU WERE! I finally
found you, Kiiro!! Where were you wandering
off to?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーっ！　
こんなところにいた！
やっと見つけたぞ！
キイロ！！　
どこほっつき歩いてたんだよっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Kariza-kyun♪ Were you trembling in worry
for little old me? Or were you just lonely?
What a good boy you are♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
カリザきゅん♪
ぷるぷる震えて、
心配してくれたん？　
それとも寂しかったー？
きゃわいいトコあんね♡

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Don't be spouting nonsense, you damn slime
woman! What about your stupid sister's
mission?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ざっけんじゃねー
クソスライム女！
アホ姉の任務はどーなってんだよっ！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text:
Nfu... Are you curious about Big Sis's words?
...Honestly, I've got no clue about what she
meant, so... I'm just taking it easy, I
guess?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフ・
おねーちゃんのコト気になるん～？
……ぶっちゃけ
なんのせーかもナシ的な～
まー
のんびりやるし？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, GEEZ! STOP LAZING AROUND! Hurry up
and show this true power of yours already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あああもうっ！
ダラダラやってんじゃねーよ！
早く真の力とかっつーのを発揮しやがれ！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Hah! If you've got no clue, I'll force it out
of you! Now that it's come to this~
text_block_list.orig_text:
手がかりがねーなら、
無理やり引き出してやるっ！
こうなりゃ──

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Have a duel with me, Kiiro! Got it? You
CANNOT refuse!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──オレと決闘だキイロっ！
いいな、
受けて立てよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a duel between Nea and Kariza began
right before {0}'s eyes. As for who
would be the victor...
text_block_list.orig_text:
突如、
{0}の目の前で始まったネアとカリザの決闘。
果たして、
勝敗の行方は──
